title: 77.1% lower inference cost
narration: RouteWise makes AI inference cheaper while enforcing your reliability requirements. In our benchmark, it cut inference cost by seventy-seven percent compared with grounded Super. That’s about eighty dollars instead of three hundred forty-nine per million requests.

title: 98.4% correct without review. Zero wrong releases.
narration: On the same three hundred twelve synthetic conversations, ninety-eight point four percent were completed correctly without review, with zero wrong answers released. Independent human validation is complete for this dataset.

title: Benchmark first. Then route.
narration: Not every request needs your most powerful model. We benchmark NVIDIA Nemotron models on Nebius Token Factory, using the same workload and declared accuracy and latency targets. Nano handles the easy cases; Super handles requests that fail validation.

title: Choose the cheapest qualifying setup
narration: Tighten the response-time target, and the recommendation switches to Super. If the benchmark can’t show that any setup meets your requirements, RouteWise makes no recommendation.

title: Correct dates. Hold ambiguous answers.
narration: Reliability also means knowing when to stop. Here, the recorded route corrects a missing refund date from the store’s timestamp. An ambiguous date goes to human review.

title: Fresh NVIDIA Nemotron call on Nebius
narration: Here’s a fresh call to Nebius Token Factory. You can inspect the model’s raw response, the final answer, the checks, and the full request cost.

title: Take the decision into your application
narration: Download the chosen setup, requirements, and evidence. These savings cover inference usage; hosting and review cost extra. The dataset is synthetic, and a later noise test missed its latency target. RouteWise makes the savings, tradeoffs, and limits visible.
